character.description: Omo, an original chibi kitten who walks upright: soft charcoal-gray fur with no stripes, white muzzle, white chest and white paw tips, big round amber eyes, tiny pink nose, pointed ears with pink inner ear, long tail with a white tip, mint-green knitted scarf with a small white ring stitched on its end, small orange sneakers

chroma_key.name: magenta
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

fall-open.action: parachute deployment sequence, front-facing, body LARGE filling two thirds of the cell height: frame 1 free-falling with arms up and ears flying upward, frame 2 a small tan pack bursts open above its head, frame 3 the compact canopy half inflated on short lines, frame 4 the compact round canopy fully open and taut, it hanging relaxed on the straps; same body scale in every frame
